title: OpenStax verbal: another name for their standard form
stem_student: OpenStax writes a quadratic as f(x) = a(x − h)^2 + k and calls that writing standard form. What other name does OpenStax give that same writing?
stem_teacher: OpenStax uses “standard form” for a(x − h)^2 + k and also calls it vertex form. Ontario uses vertex form for that expression and standard form for ax^2 + bx + c. Keep the OpenStax naming in the stem; add the Ontario note in teacher copy only. Source: College Algebra 2e §5.1 Verbal #4.
answer_verification: OpenStax §5.1 states that because the vertex appears in f(x) = a(x − h)^2 + k, that writing is also known as the vertex form of a quadratic function. Verbal exercise 4 asks for another name for their standard form.
